STO/intra-warehouse only. Figma proves the Create Purchase Order action; SAP MM object/type, implementation, ownership and formal scope require approval. The created PO becomes API-03's STO_PO predecessor.
• Requests carry only data the caller must choose or assert. SAP derives document, material, quantity, plant and pricing context wherever the referenced document already contains them.
• Every DI in this client flow has one product line. SAP derives its internal delivery item; the portal never sends a DeliveryItem field.
• API-02 keeps the screen-aligned payload Allocations[].StorageLocation + Quantity. DMG and STG remain SAP storage locations; T2 does not recreate their downstream logic.
• API-04 is the sole stock-availability / physical-inventory read. There is no separate inventory-reconciliation endpoint, and API-04 does not post stock adjustments.

• Approved business scope: Incoterm codes FTP, FTB and EXW (EX Works); sales organizations 1000 = Shree Cement Limited and 1300 = Shree Cement East; Division 10 = Cement (TSPA-SPART). Validate the final SAP organizational-field binding before hardcoding.

• OrderAgeingDays measures predecessor sales-order/PO creation to confirmed depot arrival, or to the current date while still in transit. StockAgeingDays measures how long stock has remained in inventory. These are different measures.
• FIFO is the outbound allocation rule: the oldest eligible stock/batch is proposed first. SAP must still revalidate live stock, batch eligibility and quantity before PGI.
